account_ledger_amount_sign.name: account_ledger_amount_sign
account_ledger_amount_sign.value: case "account_ledger"."kind" when 'usage' then "account_ledger"."amount_inr" >= 0 when 'payment' then "account_ledger"."amount_inr" > 0 else "account_ledger"."amount_inr" <> 0 end

calls_recording_retention_idx.name: calls_recording_retention_idx
calls_recording_retention_idx.where: "calls"."recording_key" is not null and "calls"."recording_deleted_at" is null

phone_numbers_pool_has_no_agent.name: phone_numbers_pool_has_no_agent
phone_numbers_pool_has_no_agent.value: "phone_numbers"."org_id" is not null or "phone_numbers"."agent_id" is null

accounts_balance_check_has_secret.name: accounts_balance_check_has_secret
accounts_balance_check_has_secret.value: "accounts"."balance_check_url" is null or "accounts"."balance_check_secret_ciphertext" is not null
